description: The official original Mass Mobilization version, Canada code/row mapping, coding manual version, universe, and usage/license conditions were not verified for this unit. The assignment carries provisional ccode 20 and baseline_gate remains pending.
required_followup: Coordinator verifies the original official source/version and unit mapping before any candidate is treated as an update to the original dataset.

description: Threshold is unresolved for the Kingston Women’s March (both body-read accounts say only “dozens”), the HMR and Chicoutimi nurse sit-ins (attendance not reported), the Urgences-Santé lead (no count), and the SCAN/Burnaby search-only leads. Petitions, interviewees and search snippets are not attendance counts.
required_followup: Find event-specific person counts or credible estimates from independent contemporaneous coverage/organizers; keep petitions and general staff counts separate from event turnout.

description: The Jan. 28 Ottawa anniversary reports do not state a current government-directed demand. Kingston coverage describes solidarity on broad women’s-rights issues but no concrete public-policy ask. Hospital nursing actions target hospital management/work conditions; whether they are directed to a government or policy must be reviewed.
required_followup: Review full statements, signs, event calls and reliable reporting for a demand to the Canadian/provincial government or policy. Do not transfer demands from the 2022 convoy or infer them from a public institution alone.

description: SCAN S007 had one exact-URL attempt after a manual_review receipt whose nested return was not retained locally, then a second open without a fresh receipt; that second body is separately recorded and excluded from evidence. The peace-action page S009 returned only a Cache miss, and the CSN S014 page returned a timeout after fresh receipts. No denial is inferred for either fetch failure and none was retried.
required_followup: For any further attempt, create and manually inspect a new receipt for the exact raw URL first. Preserve the first and second SCAN attempts as separate history; use only a future properly guarded response.

description: The Ottawa evidence does not provide three independent crowd counts: CityNews credits some Canadian Press files but attributes its 200-person estimate to its reporter; Ottawa Lookout relays the 200+ count from a councillor/CTV; TVA is a separate report but counts approximately 100 truckers rather than all attendees.
required_followup: Trace the referenced CTV/Police/councillor sources if needed and record exact origin links; do not count a relay or syndicated copy as an independent count.

description: The Jan. 29 Ottawa “small convoy” attempt may be related to the Jan. 28 anniversary gathering, but a shared organizer or demand is not established. Cross-month continuation and closure were not resolved for the local nursing actions or the anniversary activity; Q013 located only search-result follow-up leads.
required_followup: Check neighboring-month local/union coverage and determine whether these are distinct actions, a continuing episode, or unrelated mobilizations before assigning an episode relation or end date.

description: This is a bounded open-web first pass, not an exhaustive Canadian sweep. English- and French-language national, week-binned, province/city, labor, health, housing, climate, Indigenous, and convoy searches were run; outlet and regional coverage remains uneven. CBC/Radio-Canada domain-targeted queries encountered tool access/robots limits, and no LexisNexis/newspaper archive search was available.
required_followup: Expand with provincial/local archives, CBC/Radio-Canada through permitted access, additional languages and archive databases; distinguish search failure from no event.

description: Opened reports describe two arrests at the Jan. 28 event and police turning away an uncounted Jan. 29 convoy attempt, but do not establish several other response dimensions. The HMR/Chicoutimi sources mention health authority or hospital management actions without conclusively tying them to the protest itself.
required_followup: Verify event-specific response sources and attribution. Keep crowd dispersal, accommodation, violence, ignore, beatings, killings and shootings unknown absent direct evidence.

description: Some useful local results remain search-only: True North convoy coverage, Radio-Canada video, CityNews pre-event expectations, the JDM hospital follow-up and CNW/CSN Urgences-Santé material. An expected crowd of 500 is pre-event and must not be substituted for actual turnout.
required_followup: Only attempt exact source URLs after a fresh access receipt and manual review; prioritize body sources that can resolve event turnout, actual execution, origin and response.
